description: This file defines the Error controller class within the Opencart admin startup namespace. It sets custom error and exception handlers to manage error display and logging during the application's startup process.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Handles setting custom PHP error and exception handlers, logs errors, and manages error display or redirect during startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes custom error and exception handlers for the application.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Custom error handler that throws an ErrorException for the PHP error encountered.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Custom exception handler that logs the exception message and decides whether to display it or redirect based on configuration.
